tasks.title: Approved plans bind by digest
tasks.objective: The approval marker stores approved_plan_sha256 (assumptions-stripped, aligning the story marker off body_sha256); record_decomposition and stage start refuse when the live plan's digest differs from the APPROVED one; plan approve refuses without a fresh matching --gate plan grill.
acceptance_criteria: an edited approved plan is refused at re-record and stage start until re-approved
plan approve refuses without a fresh passing --gate plan grill bound to the plan digest

tasks.reviewer_focus: The approval marker (plans.py cmd_approve) must bind approved_plan_sha256 = plan_digest_without_assumptions(body), NOT body_sha256 - appending an assumption keeps approval valid but editing the plan body invalidates it. record_decomposition_from_json.py AND stage start (stages.py) compare the LIVE plan's plan_digest_without_assumptions against the APPROVED marker's approved_plan_sha256 (not the record-time digest) and refuse on divergence with a re-approve message. cmd_approve requires a fresh passing --gate plan grill bound to the plan digest (mirror cmd_save require_grill). ALL plan/marker reads via evidence_path (ACC-3 is new-layout, story-scoped). Do NOT regress the story-plan save/approve flow (existing tests stay green). SCOPE: plans.py marker+approve grill, the shared approved-digest compare in factory_lib, the two refusal sites, tests only.

plan_contracts.statement: an edited approved plan is refused at re-record and stage start until re-approved
plan approve refuses without a fresh passing --gate plan grill bound to the plan digest

tasks.title: Each task is grilled, planned in plan mode, and human-approved before implementation
tasks.objective: Deterministic per-task loop: a per-task plan at .factory/stories/<KEY>/task-plans/<id>.md (evidence_path) authored in plan mode; forge task plan save + forge task approve --by bind plan_digest_without_assumptions and stamp approved_by/at into the grill; require_ready_task refuses at stage start AND delegate until the grill passed AND a matching approval exists; task_frontier_state routes author-contract->grill->author-task-plan->await-approval->stage-start.
acceptance_criteria: stage start and delegate refuse a task with no approved task plan whose digest matches, or a stale grill
forge next and the board route author-task-plan and await-approval identically from shared predicates

tasks.title: The spec is re-grilled against repo reality before plan drafting
tasks.objective: The planning branch's first action is a requirements re-grill of the confirmed spec against current repo state, recorded story-scoped (.factory/stories/<KEY>/grills/requirements.json, digest over spec body + product tree); plan save refuses without a fresh pass; rounds via AskUserQuestion.
acceptance_criteria: plan save refuses without a fresh requirements-round grill matching the spec+tree digest
forge next routes the requirements round as the first planning action

tasks.title: Stage close requires a recorded clean local review and committed work
tasks.objective: record_review_from_json.py --aspect stage-local writes a clean-review stamp into stages.json bound to {stage id, task digest, composed-brief sha, baseline, pre-commit product diff digest}; stage done refuses a missing/stale stamp, any uncommitted/staged product change, or an empty committed delta. The stamp is a gate token, not a fourth review artifact (0011).
acceptance_criteria: stage done refuses without a fresh stage-local stamp, or with uncommitted/staged product changes, or an empty committed delta
the stamp is a stages.json token and records no fourth review artifact

tasks.title: The three lenses are one run over one brief
tasks.objective: review-brief --all mints review_run_id embedding the brief sha + branch diff digest; each lens artifact echoes all three and matches current branch state; pr_ready refuses lens sets that disagree.
acceptance_criteria: pr_ready refuses when the three lens artifacts do not share one review_run_id + brief sha + branch diff digest matching current state

tasks.title: Closeout is ordered and pr_ready requires a clean tree
tasks.objective: Shared require_all_stages_done(); prerequisite chain stages -> verify -> branch review -> functional (when user_facing) -> outcome -> pr_ready (verify before review); pr_ready also requires a clean product worktree/index, repo-kind-aware evidence exclusions, and the outcome stamp on the evidence commit; quickfix/lite/degraded start refuses while any stage is active.
acceptance_criteria: pr_ready refuses out-of-order closeout, a dirty product tree/index, or a missing outcome stamp on the evidence commit
quickfix/lite/degraded start refuse while any stage is active
